method: Eliminate options (figures): common face on dice
steps: J on top in both views, so T, E, X, I form the ring around J and O is opposite J.
Left/right pairs (T,E) and (X,I) are consecutive in the same direction, so ring is T,E,X,I.
Hence X is opposite T; I and E are adjacent to X, O opposite J.
check_code:
# J on top in both views; side pairs (left,right): (T,E) and (X,I)
ring_pairs=[('T','E'),('X','I')]
# the four side faces around J form a ring T,E,a,b ; (X,I) must be consecutive in same direction
import itertools
sols=set()
for a,b in itertools.permutations(['X','I']):
    ring=['T','E',a,b]
    ok=all(any(ring[i]==p and ring[(i+1)%4]==q for i in range(4)) for p,q in ring_pairs)
    if ok: sols.add(ring[(ring.index('X')+2)%4])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=sols.pop()
opts={'A':'T','B':'O','C':'I','D':'E'}
assert ans==opts['A']
for k in 'BCD': assert ans!=opts[k]

steps: Small square with diamond: 4 corner triangles + 1 in diamond's lower-right quarter = 5.
V shape under the top edge: 2 small + 1 combined = 3.
Upper-right rectangle diagonals: 1 + 1 + 2 = 4.
Lower-left: 4 (around the left diagonals) + 2 (square with diagonal) + 1 (bottom middle) = 7.
Total 19 (treating the diamond's right vertex as lying on the frame's top edge, as drawn).

from itertools import combinations
lines=[
 ['A1','T','A3'],['A1','L','A6'],['A3','R','A8'],['A6','B','A8'],
 ['T','L'],['T','R'],['L','B'],['R','B'],
 ['F0','R','V0','W','E'],['R','Vb'],['Vb','W'],['V0','Vb','H1'],['F1','H1'],
 ['J0','K0','E1'],['E','E1','E2','E3','E4'],['K0','E2'],['E2','K3'],
 ['M1','J1','K1'],['J0','J1','J3','J4','J5'],['K1','K3','K4'],['J1','K3'],
 ['M1','M3','M4'],['N3','M3','J3','K3','E3'],['F4','N4','M4','J4','K4'],
 ['N3','N4','N5'],['F0','B','F1','F4','F5'],['F5','N5','J5','E4'],
 ['F4','N3'],['M3','N4'],['F4','N5'],['M4','J5'],
]
pts=sorted({p for l in lines for p in l})
def on(a,b): return any(a in l and b in l for l in lines)
n=sum(1 for a,b,c in combinations(pts,3) if on(a,b) and on(b,c) and on(a,c) and not any(a in l and b in l and c in l for l in lines))
opts={'A':19,'B':18,'C':17,'D':16}

for k in 'BCD': assert n!=opts[k]
